explication: Pomotroid is a desktop Pomodoro timer: users configure work and break rounds, run the timer, and review completed-session statistics. The Svelte interface communicates with a Rust/Tauri backend through typed IPC; Rust owns timer execution, persistence, and desktop integrations. Major documented branches include themes, localization, audio, shortcuts, tray controls, notifications, and the optional localhost WebSocket API. The README documents capabilities beyond the sampled implementation excerpts, so only clearly supported wiring is shown; the statistics data path is represented at the documented subsystem level.
